title: OGR-MARL: Option-Guided Residual Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Heterogeneous USV Cooperative Pursuit in Constrained Port Waterways
abstract: arXiv:2608.12995v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Heterogeneous USV cooperative pursuit in constrained port waterways requires evader interception under navigation, traffic, and role constraints. This paper proposes OGR-MARL, an option-guided residual multi-agent reinforcement learning framework that is decoupled from a specific MARL algorithm. OGR-MARL integrates shared evader belief, role-conditioned option targets, adaptive rule penalties, and residual policy learning, allowing different MARL algorithms to learn corrective actions on top of rule-guided behaviors rather than exploring constrained port environments from scratch. We instantiate OGR-MARL with representative continuous-control MARL backbones, including MADDPG, MATD3, MAPPO, and MASAC, yielding OGR-MADDPG, OGR-MATD3, OGR-MAPPO, and OGR-MASAC. translated_title: OGR-MARL：面向受限港口水道异构USV协同追捕的选项引导残差多智能体强化学习
translated_abstract: 摘要：在受限港口水道中，异构USV（无人水面艇）协同追捕需要在导航、交通和角色约束下实现逃逸者拦截。本文提出OGR-MARL，一种与特定MARL算法解耦的选项引导残差多智能体强化学习框架。OGR-MARL整合了共享逃逸者信念、角色条件选项目标、自适应规则惩罚和残差策略学习，使不同MARL算法能够在规则引导行为之上学习修正动作，而非从零探索受限港口环境。我们使用代表性连续控制MARL骨干算法实例化OGR-MARL，包括MADDPG、MATD3、MAPPO和MASAC，分别生成OGR-MADDPG、OGR-MATD3、OGR-MAPPO和OGR-MASAC。在抽象的夏之门港口水道场景中的实验表明，OGR-MASAC实例实现了75.0%的捕获率，展现出任务有效的规则合规性，且该模型……
tldr: 本文提出一种与算法无关的选项引导残差多智能体强化学习框架，通过整合共享信念、角色选项和规则惩罚，使多种MARL算法在受限港口水道中高效实现异构USV协同追捕，其中OGR-MASAC达到75%的捕获率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an algorithm-agnostic option-guided residual MARL framework that integrates shared beliefs, role-conditioned options, and rule penalties to enable heterogeneous USV cooperative pursuit in constrained port waterways, with OGR-MASAC achieving a 75% capture rate.
